The Handwash That Changed the World

In 1847 Vienna, Dr. Semmelweis faced a deadly mystery: why were new mothers dying? His simple, radical solution — handwashing with chlorinated lime — pioneered antiseptic practices, but not without resistance. 🧤 How did this 'trivial' act become the bedrock of modern medicine? #History #MedicalBreakthrough
